name: Azure Storage redundancy
short_description: The replication options for Azure Storage data: locally redundant storage (LRS) keeps three copies in one datacenter, zone-redundant storage (ZRS) spreads them across availability zones, and geo-redundant options (GRS, GZRS) add a copy in a secondary region.

evidence.quote: Ultra disk only supports locally redundant storage or LRS.
Premium SSD V2 is currently only available with locally redundant storage or LRS.
The first option is LRS locally redundant storage. Three copies in a single data center.
